config_name: Legion Pro 7 16" — Core Ultra 9 275HX, RTX 5080 16GB, 32GB DDR5, 2TB SSD, 16" WQXGA IPS

specs.keyboard_notes: Per-key RGB, no TrackPoint; keys not centered on numpad

battery.notes: 99.9Wh. RTINGS measured sub-5h browsing on the OLED config; IPS tier marginally more efficient.

price.notes: BBY API 2026-11-24: regular $8,570 / sale $5,999 (marketplace seller, online only).

offers.name: Lenovo Legion Pro 7 16" WQXGA Gaming Laptop - Intel Ultra 9 275HX - 32GB DDR5 - 2TB SSD - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 - Windows 11 Pro - Black

reviews.quote: The Lenovo Legion Pro 7i is excellent for gaming. Our RTX 5080 configuration achieves high frame rates across demanding games, including titles with ray tracing.
The Legion Pro 7i has disappointing battery life. The RTX 5080 configuration lasts under five hours while browsing the web.

praises: 2TB from the factory means 4-5 AAA games installed without juggling libraries — the second M.2 slot still free for expansion
Full 175W RTX 5080 and Core Ultra 9 with no panel compromise on speed — same all-aluminum chassis as every tier
IPS panel sidesteps OLED burn-in for streamers and productivity users with static UI
$200 over the 1TB IPS SKU is cheaper than buying and cloning a 2TB drive yourself
Anti-glare matte panel + 500 nits is the most workable display in the lineup for bright rooms
complaints: Still no OLED at this price when the 32GB/1TB OLED SKU sells for only ~$250 more
IPS backlight bleed and weaker contrast vs the OLED tier in dark rooms
Line-wide RTX 5080 TDR/nvlddmkm crash reports on some units temper confidence
Fan noise and keyboard-deck heat under sustained load; needs the 400W adapter plugged in

design_philosophy: The storage-loaded IPS build of Lenovo's flagship 16-inch gaming line: same 175W RTX 5080, Core Ultra 9, and aluminum chassis, with 32GB RAM and a roomy 2TB SSD for users who install large game libraries or edit locally without managing drives on day one.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from RTINGS' reviewed OLED RTX 5080 config (8.7) per SHARED-legion-pro7.md deltas: IPS panel → screen_quality -1.0, readability_dark -1.5, readability_bright +0.3, battery +0.2; 2TB storage → creative_work +0.3 headroom vs 1TB. Refresh not stated in BBY title; 240Hz assumed per line standard.
